# search-map

These instructions extend the repository constitution for matching paths.

- Canonical Place/Destination ownership must be preserved.
- Search and Map must converge on the same canonical entities and IDs.
- Fallbacks may degrade presentation, never authority.
- Mobile navigation and location flows require browser/runtime proof.
- A material write requires an active ChangeSet claim covering the exact path.
- Evidence must name the exact source SHA and cannot be reused across non-equivalent trees.
